pulaski-mennonite-bloomfield-ia.assessment: Pulaski Mennonite Church was organized in 1861, making it one of the oldest Mennonite congregations in Iowa with a 165-year continuous Anabaptist witness in southeast Iowa's Davis County. The church reports 100+ members and is currently in a pastoral transition, seeking a lead pastor with strong commitment to Anabaptist values and CMC/Rosedale theology. Until a new lead pastor is called, male elders maintain congregational oversight per CMC polity. The confessional CMC/Rosedale Network affiliation provides clear complementarian polity and conservative Anabaptist accountability. Green rating reflects strong denominational integrity despite the pastoral search.

score_notes.cultural: Plain Iowa Anabaptist witness — Pulaski is one of the oldest CMC congregations in the Midwest.
score_notes.leadership: Pulpit currently vacant per ChurchStaffing; male elders provide continuity per CMC polity.
